_meta.no_deed_text: No Deed Book Found or Provided
_meta.deed_formats: South Dakota register of deeds references are book and page. District III CAMA layers carry CAMA_BOOK / CAMA_PAGE (e.g. '105' / '614', Sanborn '50X' / '321') or the last-sale BOOK1 / PAGE1 (Day 'B171' / '471', Tripp '82 D' / '614'); Aurora and Hutchinson have a single RECORDING text field ('67/392', 'DQ-151'); Charles Mix also has OWNER_BK_PG ('E-121'). First District layers have BOOK / PAGE (Codington '427' / '2130', Beadle '1J' / '413'). Pennington has GranteeInstBook / GranteeInstPage for older deeds and GranteeInstDocNo (e.g. 202607100) for recent instrument-numbered deeds. Meade has DEL_DEED_BOOK / DEL_DEED_PAGE. Field examples per county in deed_format.
_meta.plat_formats: Lawrence has a PLAT field (subdivision plat name/number); no plat book/page fields found elsewhere.
